Anika: Quick sync — Valence co-sell POC asks: 6-week pilot, SSO/SAML, enterprise security questionnaire due Mon, expected peak 500 rps, avg prompt length 60 tokens. Need pricing estimate (hosted vs dedicated) and deployment recommendation.
Leo: For 500 rps with 60 tokens -> ~1.8M tokens/day. Hosted can work but predictability suggests Dedicated (reserved) or Hosted+Reserved. If Dedicated, recommend 2 GPUs with autoscale to 4 for headroom. We'll send a cost ballpark.
Maria (Valence): Confirming 6-week target. Need canary in EU region + SSO. Also can you provide test accounts with sample data for integration?
Samira: Security blockers to watch: data residency, SOC2 evidence, customer-managed KMS, SAML metadata, IP allowlist. We'll need the completed security questionnaire by EOD Wed to hit timeline. For now, suggested language to paste into the questionnaire: "Data stored in customer-controlled VPC (Private deployment) or encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys (KMS). Access via RBAC; audit logs retained for 90 days." Also request pen-test report and any vendor attestation.
Leo: SSO notes: we support SAML and OIDC. For SAML we need the IdP metadata and the SP ACS URL: `https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs`. Default attribute mapping: NameID -> email, groups -> role.
Leo: Lightweight example SAML attr mapping snippet:
```
NameID -> email
eduPersonAffiliation -> role
```
Anika: Pricing (ballpark): Hosted: ~ $0.0003 per generation token (model dependent). For ~1.8M tokens/day ≈ $540/day (order-of-magnitude). Dedicated (reserved) baseline: roughly $20k/month for a 2-GPU pool with autoscaling + networking; final quote after detailed sizing. Also offer hybrid: hosted with reserved concurrency for bursts.
Maria (Valence): Partner ops want a short failover/runbook for overload scenarios — what happens to requests, how do we surface degraded performance?
Leo: Runbook snippet: If latency p95 > 300ms -> route new requests to fallback lighter model (gpt-lite-v1), enqueue large batches, notify on-call, scale up dedicated pool. Escalation: 1) route, 2) scale, 3) invoke incident bridge. I'll create a short doc we can share.
ops-bot: Created internal ticket INC-2026 for ent-sec questionnaire items and attached checklist.
Samira: I'll prepare SAML + KMS wording, upload SOC2/HIPAA artifacts to the partner portal, and flag any outstanding control gaps. Need Valence to share SSO metadata and IP ranges this week. Security review ETA ~2 weeks after we receive docs.
Anika: Action items: I will prepare pricing slide and draft POC success criteria. Can we do a 30-min joint kickoff Thu 10am PT?
Maria (Valence): Thu 10am PT works for our team. Please include partner-enable material and a demo account. :thumbsup:
Leo: I'll bring an architecture diagram and the fallback plan to the kickoff.
Samira: I'll bring the security checklist and required artifacts list.
Anika: Great — next steps captured in INC-2026. Closing thread once kickoff scheduled.
